title: Basement signage / Stage 5 standalone raster proposals
scope: Ten original PNGs, one image generation per concept. Stage 5 review before vector tracing.
approval_status: All ten compositions selected as the basis for the approved Stage 5 SVGs.

designs.title: Employees Only
designs.alt: Wide cream and bottle-green Employees Only plaque with the wizard and staff
designs.description: A small masthead identifies staff access without making the mascot the first thing to read.

inputs.role: Existing native scenes used in a material reference sheet

designs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: one raster signage concept for Total (in)Sanitation.
Input 1 is an existing sign and informs only type and palette. Input 2 is the exact approved one-color wizard pose to reproduce as the sign pictogram. Keep its faceless circle head, bent pointed hat, clean outline, pose, proportions, hands and accessories as provided. Ignore all words from Input 1.
Input 3 shows actual concrete corridors, stairs and a steel gate in this fictional game's basement. Use it only to inform practical enamel or screen-printed material and restrained edge wear. Render ONE complete standalone sign face seen absolutely straight-on on a narrow plain warm-gray studio surround. Keep all four edges and corners visible, with a clear external margin. The sign should be perfectly readable, flat and clean in the message area. No actual wall, room, scene, hands holding the sign, mockup perspective, cast shadow, props, logos, small codes or extra words. Letters are exact English as supplied. Visually belongs to a circa-1975 pharmaceutical firm's back-of-house wayfinding and safety family.
A wide horizontal gate or staff-door plaque, dark bottle-green enamel with large cream capitals, a fine cream keyline, a small cream vertical divider and one modest cream wizard pictogram block on the left. Keep the wizard's lowered free hand and upright staff as in Input 2. Heavy square-shouldered geometric sans with balanced tracking. The only words are "EMPLOYEES ONLY", comfortably centered on one line in the text field.
designs.review_note: The raster points left. For a staff-door plate, compare the approved neutral pose during the vector pass.
